name: Island Pacific Distributors
description: Founded on October 2, 1978 by Barbara and Leon Wolfley, Island Pacific Distributors (IPD) began our humble beginnings at our King Street location, opening our doors to customers as a Wholesale Hardware and Locksmith Supply Company. IPD concentrated on supplying high security keys and locks for perimeter doors on many of the high-rise condominiums being built during the high-rise boom in Waikiki and along the Ala Wai Corridor. Along with condominiums, we sold to many of the local retail establishments of the time including McDonalds, Liberty House, Gibson’s, Handyman Hardware, Holiday Mart Hardware, Ben Franklin Stores, & J.C. Penny’s.

name: J & R Senior Sheetmetal, Inc.
description: J&R Senior Sheetmetal Inc., a family-owned and operated business in Westerly, Rhode Island, specializes in custom copper work. Serving most of Rhode Island, including Block Island, we bring 30 years of metal experience across three generations and over 40 years of roofing expertise to ensure your home stays dry. We take pride in tackling the unique challenges of building coastal homes and prioritize providing quality service and products that withstand the harsh New England weather. If you can build it, we can cover it (in metal, of course). Over the past 30 years, we have earned a reputation for using innovative approaches to help our clients achieve their goals. We provide exceptional customer service and work closely with builders, roofers, and homeowners to fully understand their needs and expectations.

name: J. Holtz Furniture
description: J. Holtz Furniture specializes in working with customers to create unique pieces of furniture. I find the commission process enjoyable, as do most of my customers. There is an initial consultation where we discuss ideas, function, and general aesthetics. Next I present several sketches and get a sense of which direction to proceed. I then refine the idea and do scale drawings and give a quote. If things are agreeable I collect a deposit and put the job on the schedule. Please give me a call or email to discuss your ideas.
